approval.title: Allow this development project?
approval.subtitle: Nimi Desktop will supervise this project's build, dev server, and native host. Project approval does not grant access to protected Nimi resources.
approval.warning: Only approve a project you are actively developing. This authorization cannot become a store listing or production release.
approval.nativeRiskAcknowledgement: I understand this project can build and run native Windows code with my user privileges. I have reviewed and trust this exact project root.

field.noExtraPermissions: No additional Nimi permissions. App-owned storage, SQLite, media, settings, and routes do not require Nimi approval.

activity.title: Development activity
activity.description: Live supervised runs and recent fail-closed states. No token, ticket, session, credential, or Runtime endpoint is exposed here.
activity.empty: No local development activity has been recorded in this Desktop session.
activity.retryable: Desktop will retry while this command remains active.

management.title: Authorized development projects
management.description: Remembered projects are bound to the exact project root, app ID, shell, permission requirements, and Nimi account. Project approval does not create a Nimi permission decision. Revocation immediately closes active development access.
management.empty: No development projects are authorized for this account.
management.revokeConfirm: The running development host will lose access immediately.
